test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: If (4y-(4)/(y))=11, find the value of (y²+(1)/(y²)).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given, 4(y − 1/y) = 11 ⇒ y − 1/y = 11/4

Direct formula: If x − 1/x = a, then x² + 1/x² = a² + 2

⇒ y² + 1/y² = (11/4)² + 2

⇒ y² + 1/y² = 121/16 + 2 = 153/16

⇒ 153/16 = 9 ⁹/₁₆

**∴ The correct answer is 9 ⁹/₁₆.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

4y − 4/y = 11

**Formula Used:**

(a − b)² = a² + b² − 2ab

**Calculations:**

⇒ 4(y − 1/y) = 11

⇒ y − 1/y = 11/4

Squaring both sides:

⇒ (y − 1/y)² = (11/4)²

⇒ y² + 1/y² − 2 × y × (1/y) = 121/16

⇒ y² + 1/y² − 2 = 121/16

⇒ y² + 1/y² = 121/16 + 2

⇒ y² + 1/y² = (121 + 32) / 16

⇒ y² + 1/y² = 153/16 = 9 ⁹/₁₆

**∴ The correct answer is 9 ⁹/₁₆.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Algebraic Identities for Squares

If x + 1/x = a, then x² + 1/x² = a² − 2

Algebraic Identities for Cubes

If x + 1/x = a, then x³ + 1/x³ = a³ − 3a

Difference to Sum Conversion

If x − 1/x = a, then x + 1/x = √(a² + 4)
